description: Encode UTF-8 text to Base64, or decode Base64 back to text. Supports the URL-safe alphabet (RFC 4648 §5) and tolerates missing padding when decoding. Use this rather than computing Base64 by hand, which models get wrong on anything longer than a few bytes.

text.description: Text to encode, or Base64 to decode.

url_safe.description: When encoding, use the URL-safe alphabet (- and _) without padding.

name: base64
title: Base64 encode / decode
